decks.name: CISSP Domain 4: Communication and Network Security

questions.question: Gary wants to distribute a large file and prefers a peer-to-peer content delivery network (CDN). Which of the following is the MOST common example of this type of technology?
What is the purpose of a virtual domain (VDOM)?

options.A: They combine multiple virtual instances into a single domain
options.B: They divide a firewall device or appliance into two or more virtual firewalls
options.C: They create a virtual domain controller
options.D: They allow the hosting of multiple domain names for a single host

questions.question: Ben has connected his laptop to his tablet PC using an 802.11ac connection. What wireless network mode has he used to connect these devices?
Selah's and Nick's PCs simultaneously send traffic by transmitting at the same time. What network term describes the range of systems on a network that could be affected by this same issue?

Sarah is manually reviewing a packet capture of TCP traffic and finds that a system is setting the RST flag in the TCP packets it sends repeatedly during a short period of time. What does this flag mean in the TCP packet header?

options.A: RST flags mean “Rest.” The server needs traffic to briefly pause
options.B: RST flags mean “Relay-set.” The packets will be forwarded to the address set in the packet
options.C: RST flags mean “Resume Standard.” Communications will resume in their normal format
options.D: RST means “Reset.” The TCP session will be disconnected

questions.question: Gary is deploying a wireless network and wants to deploy the FASTEST possible wireless technology. Which one of the following wireless networking standards should he use?
Michele wants to replace FTP traffic with a secure replacement. What secure protocol should she select instead?
Jake has been told that there is a layer 3 problem with his network. Which of the following is associated with layer 3 in the OSI model?

options.D: Sending and receiving bits via hardware

questions.question: Frank is responsible for ensuring that his organization has reliable, supported network hardware. Which of the following is NOT a common concern for network administrators as they work to ensure their network continues to be operational?

options.A: If the devices have vendor support
options.B: If the devices are under warranty
options.C: If major devices support redundant power supplies
options.D: If all devices support redundant power supplies

questions.question: Brian is analyzing his network traffic and is focused on the variance of the delay between packets of data that are sent between two of his sites. What is he analyzing?
Which ONE of the following protocols is commonly used to provide back-end authentication services for a VPN?
Isaac wants to ensure that his VoIP session initialization is secure. What protocol should he ensure is enabled and required?

[Scenario: Chris is designing layered network security for his organization. Diagram: Internet → Firewall → Web Server zone + (Router → VPN Concentrator zone → Switch → Workstations).] What type of firewall design is shown in the diagram?

[Scenario: Chris is designing layered network security for his organization. Diagram: Internet → Firewall → Web Server zone + (Router → VPN Concentrator zone → Switch → Workstations).] If the VPN grants remote users the same access to network and system resources as local workstations have, what security issue should Chris raise?

options.A: VPN users will not be able to access the web server
options.B: There is no additional security issue; the VPN concentrator's logical network location matches the logical network location of the workstations
options.C: Web server traffic is not subjected to stateful inspection
options.D: VPN users should only connect from managed PCs

questions.question: [Scenario: Chris is designing layered network security for his organization.] Chris wants to implement security controls in his data center at the level of individual services and workloads. He plans to use firewall rules and other controls as well as on-demand access to services as part of his security design. What design concept is he implementing?
[Scenario: Chris is designing layered network security for his organization.] As part of his segmentation approach, Chris also wants to segment network routes. What type of solution should he select?
Ben has configured his network to not broadcast an SSID. Why might Ben disable SSID broadcast, and how could his SSID be discovered?

options.A: Disabling SSID broadcast prevents attackers from discovering the encryption key. The SSID can be recovered from decrypted packets
options.B: Disabling SSID broadcast hides networks from unauthorized personnel. The SSID can be discovered using a wireless sniffer
options.C: Disabling SSID broadcast prevents issues with beacon frames. The SSID can be recovered by reconstructing the BSSID
options.D: Disabling SSID broadcast helps avoid SSID conflicts. The SSID can be discovered by attempting to connect to the network

questions.question: Chuck is in charge of a commercial data center that handles many customers who host their servers there. He wants to be able to configure his data center network to adjust to traffic pattern changes and to manage bandwidth and other options. What technology should he implement to allow central, programmatic control of his network?
Susan wants to access her company's SAN via Ethernet and knows that she can access it as a block-level storage device. What converged protocol is she MOST likely to use?
Melissa wants to leverage a cloud service provider's edge services. What will peering allow her to do in this scenario?

options.A: Ensure that a copy of any data stored in the cloud is also replicated in her local data center
options.B: Provide a direct path from her on-premises network to the cloud provider's services
options.C: Control traffic flows via software-defined routes
options.D: Host copies of her sites at multiple locations hosted by her cloud computing service provider

questions.question: Jake wants to describe traffic sent between servers in his data center. What common terminology should he use to describe this?

During a security assessment, Jim discovers that the organization he is working with uses a multilayer protocol to handle SCADA systems and recently connected the SCADA network to the rest of the organization's production network. What concern should he raise about serial data transfers carried via TCP/IP?

options.A: SCADA devices that are now connected to the network can be attacked over the network
options.B: Serial data over TCP/IP cannot be encrypted
options.C: Serial data cannot be carried in TCP packets
options.D: TCP/IP's throughput can allow for easy denial-of-service attacks against serial devices

questions.question: Ben provides networking and security services for a small chain of coffee shops. The coffee shop chain wants to provide secure, free wireless for customers. Which of the following is the BEST option available to Ben to allow customers to connect securely to his wireless network without needing a user account if Ben does not need to worry about protocol support issues?
Alicia's company has implemented multifactor authentication using SMS messages to provide a numeric code. What is the PRIMARY security concern that Alicia may want to express about this design?

options.B: SMS messages can be spoofed by senders
options.C: SMS messages may be received by more than one phone
options.D: SMS messages may be stored on the receiving phone

questions.question: What speed and frequency range are used by 802.11ac?
The Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) and the Reverse Address Resolution Protocol (RARP) operate at what layer of the OSI model?
Which of the following is a converged protocol that allows storage mounts over TCP, and which is frequently used as a lower-cost alternative to Fibre Channel?
Chris is building an Ethernet network and knows that he needs to span a distance of more than 150 meters with his 1000BaseT network. What network technology should he use to help with this?

options.A: Install a repeater, a switch, or a concentrator before 100 meters
options.B: Use Category 7 cable, which has better shielding for higher speeds
options.C: Install a gateway to handle the distance
options.D: Use STP cable to handle the longer distance at high speeds

questions.question: [Scenario: Selah's organization has used a popular messaging service for a number of years. Diagram: System A (internal) → Switch → Router → Firewall → Internet → System B (external); System C (internal) can see traffic.] What protocol is the messaging traffic MOST likely to use based on the diagram?

[Scenario: Selah's organization has used a popular messaging service for a number of years. Diagram: System A (internal) → Switch → Router → Firewall → Internet → System B (external); System C (internal) can see traffic.] What security concern does sending internal communications from A to B raise?

options.A: The firewall does not protect system B
options.B: System C can see the broadcast traffic from system A to B
options.C: It is traveling via an unencrypted protocol

questions.question: [Scenario: Selah's organization has used a popular messaging service for a number of years.] How could Selah's company BEST address a desire for secure messaging for users of internal systems A and C?

options.B: Implement and use a locally hosted service
options.D: Discontinue use of messaging and instead use email, which is more secure

questions.question: Which of the following drawbacks is a concern when multilayer protocols are allowed?

options.A: A range of protocols may be used at higher layers
options.D: Encryption can't be incorporated at multiple layers

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a converged protocol?

Chris uses a cellular hot spot to provide Internet access when he is traveling. If he leaves the hot spot connected to his PC while his PC is on his organization's corporate network, what security issue might he cause?

options.A: Traffic may not be routed properly, exposing sensitive data
options.B: His system may act as a bridge from the Internet to the local network
options.C: His system may be a portal for a reflected DDoS attack
options.D: Security administrators may not be able to determine his IP address if a security issue occurs

questions.question: Sarah has been asked to improve the observability of her network. Which of the following is NOT a common step to improve observability?

options.C: Implement logging using a standardized format

questions.question: What features can IPsec provide for secure communication?

options.A: Encryption, access control, nonrepudiation, and message authentication
options.B: Protocol convergence, content distribution, micro-segmentation, and network virtualization
options.C: Encryption, authorization, nonrepudiation, and message integrity checking
options.D: Micro-segmentation, network virtualization, encryption, and message authentication

questions.question: Casey has been asked to determine if Zigbee network traffic can be secured in transit. What security mechanism does Zigbee use to protect data traffic?
Sue modifies her MAC address to one that is allowed on a network that uses MAC filtering to provide security. What is the technique Sue used, and what nonsecurity issue could her actions cause?
Joanna wants to deploy 4G LTE as an out-of-band management solution for devices at remote sites. Which of the following security capabilities is NOT commonly available from 4G service providers?

options.C: Dedicated towers and antennas for secure service subscribers

questions.question: SMTP, HTTP, and SNMP all occur at what layer of the OSI model?
Mark's organization hosts their infrastructure in a cloud IaaS environment. They operate in a private, isolated, and secure cloud that they configure. What term BEST describes this?
Selah wants to provide port-based authentication on her network to ensure that clients must authenticate before using the network. What technology is an appropriate solution for this requirement?

Ben has deployed a 1000BaseT gigabit network and needs to run a cable across a large building. If Ben is running his link directly from a switch to another switch in that building, what is the maximum distance Ben can cover according to the 1000BaseT specification?
What security control does MAC cloning attempt to bypass for wired networks?

The company that Kathleen works for has moved to remote work for most employees and wants to ensure that the multimedia collaboration platform that they use for voice, video, and text-based collaboration is secure. Which of the following security options will provide the BEST user experience while providing appropriate security for communications?

options.A: Require software-based VPN to the corporate network for all use of the collaboration platform
options.B: Require the use of SIPS and SRTP for all communications
options.C: Use TLS for all traffic for the collaboration platform
options.D: Deploy secure VPN endpoints to each remote location and use a point-to-point VPN for communications

questions.question: Chris wants to use a low-power, personal area network (PAN) wireless protocol for a device he is designing. Which of the following wireless protocols is BEST suited to creating small, low-power devices that can connect to each other at relatively short distances across buildings or rooms?

Olga wants to provide out-of-band management for her SCADA devices, which are deployed across her organization's large physical infrastructure in multiple distinct production facilities. Which of the following is an appropriate solution to meet her needs?

options.A: Administrative access via a web client installed on each system that requires Windows-based domain authentication
options.B: Administrative access via nonstandard ports using a secure protocol like SSH
options.C: Administrative access via a second, physically separate Ethernet network with access controlled via VPN and multifactor authentication
options.D: Administrative access via physical access to the devices when needed

questions.question: Cameron is worried about distributed denial-of-service attacks against his company's primary web application. Which of the following options will provide the MOST resilience against large-scale DDoS attacks?

options.B: Increasing the number of servers in the web application server cluster
options.C: Contract for DDoS mitigation services via the company's ISP
options.D: Increasing the amount of bandwidth available from one or more ISPs

questions.question: There are four common VPN protocols. Which group listed contains ALL of the common VPN protocols?
Wayne wants to deploy a secure voice communication network. Which of the following techniques should he consider? (Reframed: Which ONE of the following is NOT a recommended technique?)

options.A: Use a dedicated VLAN for VoIP phones and devices
options.B: Require the use of SIPS and SRTP
options.C: Require the use of VPN for all remote VoIP devices

questions.question: Which OSI layer includes electrical specifications, protocols, and interface standards?
Ben is designing a Wi-Fi network and has been asked to choose the MOST secure option for the network. Which wireless security standard should he choose?
What mode of switching is BEST suited to low-latency, high-throughput data transfer?
Segmentation, sequencing, and error checking all occur at what layer of the OSI model that is associated with SSL, TLS, and UDP?
The Windows ipconfig command displays the following information: BC-5F-F4-7B-4B-7D. What term describes this, and what information can usually be gathered from it?

options.A: The IP address, the network location of the system
options.B: The MAC address, the network interface card's manufacturer
options.C: The MAC address, the media type in use
options.D: The IPv6 client ID, the network interface card's manufacturer

questions.question: Chris wants to ensure that traffic sent via his backhaul networks provided by third-party telecom providers is secure. Which of the following options is BEST suited to ensuring that all traffic sent through the connection is secure?

options.A: Use TLS for all web services

questions.question: Ben is troubleshooting a network and discovers that the NAT router he is connected to has the 192.168.x.x subnet as its internal network and that its external IP is 192.168.1.40. What problem is he encountering?

options.A: 192.168.x.x is a nonroutable network and will not be carried to the Internet
options.B: 192.168.1.40 is not a valid address because it is reserved by RFC 1918
options.C: Double NATing is not possible using the same IP range
options.D: The upstream system is unable to de-encapsulate his packets, and he needs to use PAT instead

questions.question: What is the default subnet mask for a Class B network?
Kim wants to protect her Zoom meetings from Zoom bombing. What security option should she enable?
Olivia wants to use a network fault management tool that can provide real-time fault detection. What capabilities are MOST commonly associated with this type of monitoring?

options.A: SNMP and ICMP-based monitoring and diagnostic data retrieval

questions.question: Selah's organization has deployed VoIP phones on the same switches that the desktop PCs are on. What security issue could this create, and what solution would help?

options.A: VLAN hopping; use physically separate switches
options.D: Denial-of-service attacks; use a firewall between networks

questions.question: [Scenario: Susan is designing her organization's new network infrastructure for a branch office.] Susan wants to use a set of nonroutable IP addresses for the location's internal network addresses. Using your knowledge of secure network design principles and IP networking, which of the following IP ranges are usable for that purpose? (Reframed: Which ONE is NOT usable?)

[Scenario: Susan is designing her organization's new network infrastructure for a branch office.] Susan knows that she will need to implement a Wi-Fi network for her customers and wants to gather information about the customers, such as their email address, without having to provide them with a wireless network password or key. What type of solution would provide this combination of features?

[Scenario: Susan is designing her organization's new network infrastructure for a branch office.] With her wireless network set up, Susan moves on to ensuring that her network will remain operational even if disruptions occur. What is the SIMPLEST way she can ensure that her network devices, including her router, access points, and network switches, stay on if a brownout or other temporary power issue occurs?

options.A: Purchase and install a generator with an automatic start
options.B: Deploy dual power supplies for all network devices
options.C: Install UPS systems to cover all network devices that must remain online
options.D: Contract with multiple different power companies for redundant power

questions.question: [Scenario: Susan is designing her organization's new network infrastructure for a branch office.] Derek wants to deploy redundant core routers, as shown in the diagram. What model of high availability clustering will provide him with the GREATEST throughput?
Angela needs access to manage IoT devices at multiple sites that her organization manages. What solution should she suggest to ensure access and security for the devices?

options.B: An IDS located at the network edge protecting a network using only private IP addresses
options.C: A DLP system configured to prevent attacks against IoT devices
options.D: An iSCSI-based security solution accessed using a VPN and jump boxes

questions.question: What is a frequent concern for systems that require high-performing Internet connectivity when satellite Internet is the ONLY available option?
What layer of an SDN implementation uses programs to communicate needs for resources via APIs?
Which of the following is NOT a drawback of multilayer protocols?

options.A: They can allow filters and rules to be bypassed
options.B: They can operate at higher OSI levels
options.D: They can allow network segment boundaries to be bypassed

questions.question: Place the following layers of the TCP/IP model in order, starting with the Application layer and moving down the stack.

Aadita's company wants to ensure that their website is highly available and resistant to potential denial-of-service attacks. What type of solution would be BEST suited to this if the company operates an e-commerce site that serves multiple countries and regions with a very large number of customers?
What are two primary advantages that 5G networks have over 4G networks? (Reframed: Which ONE is NOT a primary advantage?)
What function does VXLAN perform in a data center environment? (Reframed: Which ONE is NOT accurate?)

options.A: It removes limitations due to maximum distance for Ethernet cables
options.B: It allows multiple subnets to exist in the same IP space with hosts using the same IP addresses
options.C: It tunnels layer 2 connections over a layer 3 network, stretching them across the underlying layer 3 network

questions.question: Chris is setting up a hotel network and needs to ensure that systems in each room or suite can connect to each other, but systems in other suites or rooms cannot. At the same time, he needs to ensure that all systems in the hotel can reach the Internet. What solution should he recommend as the MOST effective business solution?

During a forensic investigation, Charles is able to determine the Media Access Control (MAC) address of a system that was connected to a compromised network. Charles knows that MAC addresses are tied back to a manufacturer or vendor and are part of the fingerprint of the system. To which OSI layer does a MAC address belong?

Mikayla is reviewing her organization's VoIP environment configuration and finds a diagram that shows the following design. What concern should she express? (Diagram: VoIP phone → SIP + SRTP → VoIP PBX)

options.A: The voice connection is unencrypted and could be listened to
options.B: There are no security issues in this diagram
options.C: The session initialization connection is unencrypted and could be viewed
options.D: Both the session initialization and voice data connection are unencrypted and could be captured and analyzed

questions.question: Jake's company keeps their certificate signing server disconnected from the network to prevent it from being compromised by network attacks. What is this type of solution called?
What converged protocol is designed to allow high-speed communication to devices like CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators?
Mark is concerned about the physical security of his network cables. What type of network connection would be the HARDEST to tap without specialized equipment?

Rich wants to connect his network to a building a half-mile away from his current location. There are trees and terrain features along the way, but a road passes between the trees to the other location. What type of transmission media is BEST suited to this type of deployment?

options.A: Ethernet cable with repeaters every 200 to 300 yards

questions.question: What challenge is MOST common for endpoint security system deployments?

options.C: Monitoring encrypted traffic on the network

questions.question: What type of address is 127.0.0.1?

Susan is writing a best practices statement for her organizational users who need to use Bluetooth. She knows that there are many potential security issues with Bluetooth and wants to provide the best advice she can. Which of the following sets of guidance should Susan include? (Reframed: Which ONE is NOT accurate advice?)

options.A: Use Bluetooth's built-in strong encryption, change the default PIN on your device, turn off discovery mode, and turn off Bluetooth when it's not in active use
options.B: Use Bluetooth only for those activities that are not confidential, change the default PIN on your device, turn off discovery mode, and turn off Bluetooth when it's not in active use
options.C: Use Bluetooth's built-in strong encryption, use extended (eight digits or longer) Bluetooth PINs, turn off discovery mode, and turn off Bluetooth when it's not in active use
options.D: Use Bluetooth only for those activities that are not confidential, use extended (eight digits or longer) Bluetooth PINs, turn off discovery mode, and turn off Bluetooth when it's not in active use
